'''Marek Konarzewski''' ({{IPA|pl|ma.rɛk kɔnaʐɛvski}}; born 18 June 1961 in [[Białystok]]) – professor of biology, popular-science author, faculty member at the [[University of Białystok]], and corresponding member of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Marek Konarzewski |url=https://biologia.uwb.edu.pl/media/uploads/2017/08/25/marek-konarzewski-bio.pdf |access-date=20 October 2022 |website=University of Białystok}}</ref> Since October 2022, President-Elect of the Polish Academy of Sciences.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=Prof. Marek Konarzewski wybrany na stanowiska prezesa PAN |url=https://www.pap.pl/aktualnosci/news%2C1458242%2Cjest-nowy-prezes-pan.html |access-date=2022-10-23 |website=Polska Agencja Prasowa SA |language=pl}}</ref><ref name=":2" />

== Background ==
Marek Konarzewski earned his master's in biology (MS) at what was then the University of Warsaw's branch campus in Białystok (now the University of Białystok). He earned both his doctorate (PhD) in 1990 followed by his higher doctorate degree (DSc) in 1996 at the [[Institute of Ecology, Polish Academy of Sciences]] – the latter based on a thesis entitled ''Allocation of Energy to Growth and Respiration in Avian Postembryonic Development''.<ref name=":0" /> In 2004 he was awarded the academic title of Professor of Biological Sciences.<ref name=":4">{{cite web|title=Członkowie korespondenci PAN. Wydział II|url=http://www.instytucja.pan.pl/index.php/czonkowie-pan/korespondenci#2-wydział-ii|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160215235254/http://www.instytucja.pan.pl/index.php/czonkowie-pan/korespondenci#2-wydział-ii |agency=pan.pl|access-date=2014-02-02|archive-date=2016-02-15 }}</ref>

== Positions ==
Konarzewski is a professor at the Department of Evolutionary and Physiological Ecology, University of Białystok, and at the Faculty of Artes Liberales, University of Warsaw. In 1991–1993 he was a post-doc researcher at the [[University of California, Los Angeles|University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA)]], at the lab of the prominent American biologist, geographer, and historian [[Jared Diamond|Jared M. Diamond]]. Since 2010 he has been a Corresponding Member of the Polish Academy of Sciences.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=Członkowie Polskiej Akademii Nauk |url=http://czlonkowie.pan.pl/czlonkowie/sites/Biogram.html?id=3619 |access-date=2022-10-23 |website=czlonkowie.pan.pl}}</ref> In 2008–2013 he held the post of Minister-Counselor for Science and Technology at the [[Embassy of Poland, Washington, D.C.|Embassy of the Republic of Poland to the United States of America]].<ref name=":0" /><ref name=":3" /> In 2017–2021 he served as Science and Technology Advisor to the [[Polish Minister of Foreign Affairs]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=How to encourage American students to attend Polish universities? |url=https://nawa.gov.pl/images/infopack_final_rev_1.pdf |website=NAWA}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Wizyta ambasadora Piotra Wilczka w Bostonie|url=https://waszyngton.msz.gov.pl/pl/aktualnosci/wizyta_ambasadora_piotra_wilczka_w_bostonie|agency=waszyngton.msz.gov.pl|date=2017-02-23|access-date=2019-05-10|language=pl}}</ref> On 20 October 2022, he was elected by the General Assembly of the [[Polish Academy of Sciences]] to become the new President of the Academy for the 2023–2026 term (and will assume the office upon being appointed by the Prime Minister).<ref name=":1" /><ref name=":2">{{cite web|title=Prof. Marek Konarzewski nowym prezesem Polskiej Akademii Nauk|url=https://edukacja.rp.pl/uczelnie-wyzsze/art37272751-prof-marek-konarzewski-nowym-prezesem-polskiej-akademii-nauk|agency=Rzeczpospolita|access-date=2022-10-21|language=pl}}</ref>

== Research Achievements ==
Konarzewski's research work focuses on physiological ecology and the emerging field of evolutionary physiology (of birds and mammals).<ref name=":0" /> He is the author or co-author of several dozen research publications; several of the most prominent are as follows:<ref name=":4" />

* {{cite journal | last=Konarzewski | first=Marek | last2=Diamond | first2=Jared | title=EVOLUTION OF BASAL METABOLIC RATE AND ORGAN MASSES IN LABORATORY MICE | journal=Evolution | publisher=Wiley | volume=49 | issue=6 | year=1995 | issn=0014-3820 | doi=10.1111/j.1558-5646.1995.tb04450.x | pages=1239–1248| doi-access=free }}
* {{cite journal | last=Kozłowski | first=J. | last2=Konarzewski | first2=M. | last3=Gawelczyk | first3=A. T. | title=Cell size as a link between noncoding DNA and metabolic rate scaling | journal=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences | publisher=Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences | volume=100 | issue=24 | date=2003-11-13 | issn=0027-8424 | doi=10.1073/pnas.2334605100 | pages=14080–14085| pmc=283549 }}
* "Is West, Brown and Enquist's Model of Allometric Scaling Mathematically Correct and Biologically Relevant?" (co-author: J. Kozłowski), ''Functional Ecology'', 18, 2004;
* "Artificial Selection on Metabolic Rates and Related Traits in Rodents" (co-authors: A. Książek, I. B. Łapo), ''Integrative and Comparative Biology'', 45, 2005;
*{{cite journal |last1=Gębczyński |first1=A. K. |last2=Konarzewski |first2=M. |title=Locomotor activity of mice divergently selected for basal metabolic rate: a test of hypotheses on the evolution of endothermy |journal=Journal of Evolutionary Biology |date=June 2009 |volume=22 |issue=6 |pages=1212–1220 |doi=10.1111/j.1420-9101.2009.01734.x}}

By 2014, he had served as the thesis advisor for six PhD students.<ref>{{cite web |title=System Wspomagania Wyboru Recenzentów |url=https://recenzenci.opi.org.pl/sssr-web/site/people-details;jsessionid=6zSnZ65hffdM2RSZpR+aKYjh.undefined?personId=fd48f3f6cb1a513b |access-date=2019-05-10 |language=pl |agency=recenzenci.opi.org.pl}}</ref>

== Science Communication ==
Konarzewski has also published numerous popular-science articles, the popular-science book ''Na początku był głód'' ["In the Beginning There Was Famine"], two photographic albums showcasing two of Poland's most outstanding natural areas (the [[Biebrza National Park|Biebrza Valley]] and the [[Knyszyn Forest]]), and a Polish translation of Jared M. Diamond's Pulitzer Prize winning book ''[[Guns, Germs, and Steel]]''.<ref name=":3" />

== Awards ==
Konarzewski has won the following awards:

* the [[Polish Prime Minister's Award]] for his DSc thesis (1997),<ref name=":02">{{cite web|title=Członkowie Polskiej Akademii Nauk|url=http://czlonkowie.pan.pl/czlonkowie/sites/Biogram.html?id=3619|agency=czlonkowie.pan.pl|access-date=2019-05-10|language=pl}}</ref>
* the silver [[Cross of Merit (Poland)|Cross of Merit]] (2004),<ref>{{Monitor Polski|2005|8|120}}</ref>
* an honorary doctorate from the [[Poznań University of Medical Sciences]] (2013),<ref>{{cite web|title=Prof. Marek Konarzewski doktorem h.c. Uniwersytetu Medycznego w Poznaniu|url=http://www.naukawpolsce.pap.pl/aktualnosci/news,398268,prof-marek-konarzewski-doktorem-hc-uniwersytetu-medycznego-w-poznaniu.html|agency=naukawpolsce.pap.pl|access-date=2014-02-02}}</ref>
* the Research Prize of Division II of the Polish Academy of Sciences (2014).<ref name=":02"/>
